_: Project Maya's quants of MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash (GGUF, llama.cpp's minimax-m3 layout; tools/mm3/pack_gguf.py packs them for maya-mm3), named as every Maya quant (tools/maya_quants.py): <Model>-Maya-<Tier>-<maintype>-0000N-of-0000M.gguf, one repo for the model, a folder per tier. The sparse-attention indexers of the dense layers 0-2 are in <name>-maya-indexers.bin beside the shards (a GGUF: .gguf up to v1.1.30, when the Hub read that lone .gguf as the model; a file under that name is used as it is): maya-mm3 loads both and runs the model as MiniMax defines it, stock llama.cpp loads the shards alone. "was": the names the files had before (in the same order), used as they are where a folder holds them whole. "revision" is the commit the files were uploaded at (2026-10-27) and each file has its sha256: the setup checks every file against it. Sizes are the files' as made (2026-10-26).
name: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash

MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Maya-XS.about: routed experts IQ1_S, the most sensitive IQ2_XXS (~1.6 bits); attention Q5_K / Q6_K, indexers Q8_0, the rest Q5_K, embedding Q4_K, head Q6_K

MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Maya-S.about: routed experts IQ2_XXS, the most sensitive IQ2_XS / IQ2_S / IQ3_XXS (~2.1 bits); attention and indexers Q8_0, the rest Q6_K
